about.title: Dental care that feels like a lounge, not a waiting room
body: Smile Lounge Dental Clinic was built on a simple idea — a trip to the dentist shouldn't feel like something to dread. Tucked into Kumananchavadi on Trunk Road, our studio swaps the usual clinical chill for a calmer, more considered space, without cutting any corners on the dentistry itself.

Whether you're in for a routine cleaning, a root canal, or a full smile makeover, our team walks you through every step in plain language, uses modern gentle-touch technique, and keeps evening slots open for people who simply can't get away during the day.

services.name: Teeth Whitening & Cosmetic Dentistry
services.overview: Professional in-office and take-home whitening options paired with cosmetic touch-ups, tailored to give you a natural, brighter smile without sensitivity.
procedure: In-office whitening or custom take-home trays
benefits: Visible results in a single session
Reduced sensitivity compared to over-the-counter kits
services.recovery: No downtime — most patients resume normal eating and drinking within a few hours.

faqs.question: How long do whitening results last?
faqs.answer: With good oral hygiene and occasional touch-ups, results typically last 12–18 months.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.overview: Modern, gentle root canal therapy to treat infected or badly decayed teeth while preserving your natural tooth wherever possible.
benefits: Completed in as few as 1–2 sittings
services.recovery: Mild sensitivity for a day or two; most patients return to normal activity the same day.

faqs.question: Is a root canal painful?
faqs.answer: With modern anesthesia and technique, most patients report far less discomfort than they expect.

services.name: Braces & Orthodontics
services.tagline: Straighter teeth, at your own pace
services.overview: Traditional braces and clear aligner options to correct crowding, gaps, and bite issues for teens and adults alike.
benefits: Options for both visible and near-invisible treatment

services.name: Dental Implants
services.tagline: A permanent fix for missing teeth
services.overview: Titanium implant placement to replace missing teeth with a fixed, natural-feeling result that functions like your own tooth.
benefits: Looks and functions like a natural tooth
services.recovery: Initial healing takes a few days; full integration typically takes 2–4 months before the final crown.

faqs.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqs.answer: With proper care, implants can last 15–20 years or longer.

services.name: Smile Makeover & Veneers
services.tagline: See your new smile before you commit
services.overview: A combination of veneers, whitening, and minor reshaping to redesign your smile, planned around what actually suits your face.
services.recovery: No downtime required after final placement.

faqs.question: How long do veneers last?
faqs.answer: With proper care, veneers typically last 10–15 years.

blogPosts.title: Why a Relaxed Visit Leads to Better Dental Care
blogPosts.excerpt: Dental anxiety keeps a lot of people away from routine checkups. Here's how a calmer environment actually changes outcomes.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Priya Ramanathan
content: A large number of patients avoid the dentist for years simply because of anxiety — not because of cost or access. That avoidance almost always makes small problems bigger and more expensive to treat.
At Smile Lounge, we designed the space intentionally around this — comfortable seating, calmer lighting, and a team that explains every step before starting, rather than after.

Modern, minimally invasive technique also plays a big role. Many procedures that used to require significant drilling or discomfort can now be done far more gently, which changes how patients feel about coming back.
The result is simple: patients who feel comfortable come in more regularly for checkups, which means problems get caught early instead of turning into root canals or extractions.
If it's been a while since your last visit, a relaxed first consultation — with no pressure to commit to treatment on the spot — is often the easiest way to get back on track.
